spec.title: Network Observability - Topology Explorer
spec.description: Interactive analysis of the discovered network graph: topology, link flow, adjacency, estate composition and device inventory.

options.content:
### Topology Explorer
The discovered L2/L3 graph of the selected discovery exporter, as reconciled from LLDP, CDP, FDB, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS and MPLS-TE walks. Filter by **vendor** (both link ends must match) and **discovery protocol**, and switch the graph between a **layered** tier view and a **force** layout. Tier is derived from the device name prefix (edge-fw, wan-core, spine, leaf, host).

Source: `network_topology_device_info`, `network_topology_edge_info`, `network_topology_device_uptime_seconds`.

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Discovered devices matching the vendor filter.

panels.title: Links
panels.description: Reconciled edges matching the vendor and protocol filters.

targets.expr: count((network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",discovery_proto=~"$proto"} and on(instance, src_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)") and on(instance, dst_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)")))

panels.title: Links per device
panels.description: Mean degree: each edge counts at both ends.

targets.expr: 2 * count((network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",discovery_proto=~"$proto"} and on(instance, src_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)") and on(instance, dst_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)"))) / count(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"})

count(count by (discovery_proto) ((network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",discovery_proto=~"$proto"} and on(instance, src_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)") and on(instance, dst_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)"))))

panels.title: Discovered topology - $exporter
panels.description: All discovered devices and reconciled links. Node colour = vendor, shape = tier, size = link count (degree). Line style = discovery protocol. Hover a node to isolate its neighbours; scroll to zoom, drag to pan. Driven by network_topology_device_info (nodes) and network_topology_edge_info (links).

targets.expr: (network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",discovery_proto=~"$proto"} and on(instance, src_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)") and on(instance, dst_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Link flow: source tier -> discovery protocol -> destination tier
panels.description: Link counts from network_topology_edge_info grouped by the tier of each end (from the device name prefix) and the protocol that discovered the link. Ribbon width = number of links.

targets.expr: count by (src_tier, discovery_proto, dst_tier) (label_replace(label_replace((network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",discovery_proto=~"$proto"} and on(instance, src_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)") and on(instance, dst_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)")), "src_tier", "$1", "src_device", "^(edge-fw|wan-core|ext-peer|spine|leaf|host).*"), "dst_tier", "$1", "dst_device", "^(edge-fw|wan-core|ext-peer|spine|leaf|host).*"))

panels.title: Estate composition: site / vendor / OS version (all exporters)
panels.description: Every discovered device across all three exporters, nested by site, then vendor, then OS version. Tile area = device count. Driven by count(network_topology_device_info).

panels.title: Fabric adjacency matrix - cell colour = discovery protocol (blue lldp, orange bgp, red mpls_te)
panels.description: Rows = link source device, columns = link destination device, grouped by tier. Cell colour = the protocol that discovered the link. Driven by network_topology_edge_info with src_device not a host.

panels.title: Tier-to-tier link counts
panels.description: Number of links from each source tier (rows) to each destination tier (columns). Driven by count by (src_tier, dst_tier) over network_topology_edge_info.

targets.expr: count by (src_tier, dst_tier) (label_replace(label_replace((network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",discovery_proto=~"$proto"} and on(instance, src_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)") and on(instance, dst_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)")), "src_tier", "$1", "src_device", "^(edge-fw|wan-core|ext-peer|spine|leaf|host).*"), "dst_tier", "$1", "dst_device", "^(edge-fw|wan-core|ext-peer|spine|leaf|host).*"))

count by (discovery_proto) ((network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",discovery_proto=~"$proto"} and on(instance, src_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)") and on(instance, dst_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)")))

count by (link_kind) ((network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",discovery_proto=~"$proto"} and on(instance, src_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)") and on(instance, dst_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)")))

panels.title: Links by vendor pair (source -> destination)
panels.description: network_topology_edge_info joined to network_topology_device_info on each end to get the source and destination vendor.

targets.expr: count by (pair) (label_join(((network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",discovery_proto=~"$proto"} and on(instance, src_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)") and on(instance, dst_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)")) * on(instance, src_device) group_left(src_vendor) label_replace(label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)"), "src_vendor", "$1", "vendor", "(.*)")) * on(instance, dst_device) group_left(dst_vendor) label_replace(label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)"), "dst_vendor", "$1", "vendor", "(.*)"), "pair", " -> ", "src_vendor", "dst_vendor"))

panels.title: Device inventory - $exporter
panels.description: One row per discovered device: identity from network_topology_device_info, uptime from network_topology_device_uptime_seconds (SNMP sysUpTime) and link count from network_topology_edge_info.

targets.expr: max by (instance, device_id, tier, vendor, os_version, site) (network_topology_device_uptime_seconds{instance="$exporter"} * on(instance, device_id) group_left(vendor, os_version, site, tier) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "tier", "$1", "device_id", "^(edge-fw|wan-core|ext-peer|spine|leaf|host).*"))

max by (instance, device_id, tier, vendor, os_version, site) (count by (instance, device_id) (label_replace(label_replace((network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",discovery_proto=~"$proto"} and on(instance, src_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)") and on(instance, dst_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)")), "device_id", "$1", "src_device", "(.*)"), "end", "src", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace((network_topology_edge_info{instance="$exporter",discovery_proto=~"$proto"} and on(instance, src_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)") and on(instance, dst_device) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)")), "device_id", "$1", "dst_device", "(.*)"), "end", "dst", "", "")) * on(instance, device_id) group_left(vendor, os_version, site, tier) label_replace(network_topology_device_info{instance="$exporter",vendor=~"$vendor"}, "tier", "$1", "device_id", "^(edge-fw|wan-core|ext-peer|spine|leaf|host).*"))
